items.markdown:
`Figma is a subscription-based software rather than a one-time purchase` . You can upgrade directly through your account or start on their free tier.

#### Official Figma Plans & Pricing

- **Starter (Free)** : Best for trying out Figma or working on personal projects. Includes unlimited drafts, UI kits, templates, and basic AI credits.[[1]](https://www.figma.com/pricing/)
- **Professional** : Ideal for freelancers and solo designers or growing teams.
	- Full seat: **$16/month** (or lower with annual billing)
	- Dev seat: **$12/month** 
	- Collab seat: **$3/month** [[1]](https://www.figma.com/pricing/)
- **Organization** : Best for scaling businesses that need centralized assets, shared libraries, and enhanced administration.
	- Full seat: **$55/month** (billed annually)
	- Dev seat: **$25/month** (billed annually)
	- Collab seat: **$5/month** (billed annually)[[1]](https://www.figma.com/pricing/)
- **Enterprise** : For large-scale organizations needing advanced security, custom workspaces, and API controls.
	- Full seat: **$90/month** (billed annually)
	- Dev seat: **$35/month** (billed annually)
	- Collab seat: **$5/month** (billed annually)[[1]](https://www.figma.com/pricing/)

*(View full feature breakdowns and pick your tier on the official [Figma Plans & Pricing Page](https://www.figma.com/pricing/).)* 

#### How to Sign Up or Upgrade

1. Go to [Figma](https://www.figma.com/) and log into (or create) your account.
2. Navigate to your team or file browser.
3. Select your team/workspace and choose to **Upgrade** to your preferred plan type via the billing settings.[[1]](https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us/articles/360046216313-Upgrade-or-downgrade-your-plan)

Are you looking to upgrade **solo as a freelancer/designer** , or are you setting this up for a **team or company** ? Let me know and I can help you figure out which seat types (Full, Dev, or Collab) you actually need.
